rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Express a relevant entropy quantity through a noise semigroup and identify an integral whose universal influence bound would imply FEI. Check both small-time and large-time integrability.

deliverables.description: SEMIGROUP_ENTROPY_REPRESENTATION.tex: exact integral and candidate dissipation
TIME_BOUNDARIES.md: small-time, large-time, and dimension dependence

acceptance_criteria: Define the semigroup, normalized or unnormalized evolving law, and the entropy quantity being differentiated.
Prove the integral identity with all boundary terms and dominate both t→0 and t→∞ in the proposed scope.
Identify the precise unproved influence bound that would close FEI; rewriting entropy as an integral does not pay that integral.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A proved new dissipation estimate on a declared regime or a sharp boundary obstruction to the proposed integral payment.

assignments.target_statement: Locate exactly where standard hypercontractivity loses a logarithmic degree or dimension factor. Seek a Boolean-specific improvement on a measurable regime, not a restatement of an already general real-valued bound.

deliverables.description: BOOLEAN_HYPERCONTRACTIVE_REFINEMENT.tex: precise loss and proposed improvement
REGIME_COMPARISON.md: old bound, new bound, and separating family

acceptance_criteria: Locate the exact logarithmic degree/dimension loss in a primary-source inequality or the recovered proof.
State a measurable regime and prove the extra Boolean hypothesis is used; a bound valid for arbitrary real functions cannot silently gain a Boolean-only conclusion.
Demonstrate a strict quantitative gain on an explicit family and replay the relevant fixed-order/near-Boolean controls.
A fixed-order spectral Rényi strengthening with α<1 is already false on a one-point defect; any scale-dependent order/correction must be stated and its full cost proved.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A real Boolean-specific improvement to one named inequality, not a renamed standard hypercontractive bound.

assignments.target_statement: Generalize the recovered pivotal-antichain estimate to a broader partially ordered or multi-scale geometry. Prove a rank-reference theorem for a class not already covered by desirability width.

deliverables.description: NEW_RANK_GEOMETRY.tex: combinatorial antichain substitute and spectral reference
WIDTH_SEPARATION_EXAMPLE.md: new class outside the published desirability-width bound

acceptance_criteria: Define the partial order or multiscale geometry and prove the pivotal property replacing the total-order antichain argument.
Construct and normalize the new rank reference; code/entropy costs must include the complexity of the geometry.
Give a family with an actual improvement over the published width/logarithmic-multiple-order theorem, rather than calling width by another name.
The mass-sensitive K_eff rank refinement is already derived under disjoint-support/fiber-antichain conditions; new geometry or global cost payment must go beyond rederiving that lemma.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A rank/reference theorem for an explicitly broader geometry with a demonstrated quantitative improvement.

assignments.target_statement: Extract an abstract encoding property from the percolation proof and ask which nongeometric Boolean families satisfy it. Prove the property directly for a new family instead of assuming spatial estimates are universal.

deliverables.description: ABSTRACT_GEOMETRIC_ENCODING.tex: extracted property with exact hypotheses
NONSPATIAL_FAMILY_PROOF.md: direct verification and cost bound

acceptance_criteria: Read the original percolation encoding proof and separate geometric arm estimates from the abstract decoding/influence statement.
Prove the extracted property directly for a named nongeometric Boolean family; spatial estimates cannot be assumed universally.
Show the full entropy cost and explain whether the new family was already covered by a different published structured theorem.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Continue only if one concrete abstract lemma and a plausible new class verification are isolated within the pilot.

assignments.target_statement: Compare every new functional inequality against normalized non-Boolean spectra and known cyclic-law failures. Identify the indispensable Boolean hypothesis and test whether it is actually used.

deliverables.description: ANALYTIC_SCOPE_AUDIT.md: indispensable hypotheses and their proof uses
RELAXATION_CONTROL_RESULTS.json: actual Boolean versus non-Boolean diagnostics

acceptance_criteria: Test each statement on its exact domain and on the strongest applicable non-Boolean relaxation as a diagnostic, labeling the two outcomes separately.
Identify the line where actual Booleanity, granularity, or geometry is used; normalization and bounded L4 alone do not replace full Booleanity.
Do not reject a valid Boolean theorem solely because a non-Boolean law violates it; locate the missing or sufficient hypothesis precisely.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One full candidate receives a reconstructible scope audit, with either a specific gap or a verified chain of hypothesis uses.
